bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 跌破 $588，守住 10 日均线

read.en: Berkshire Hathaway B fell 1.0% on Nov 17 to $586.76, trading $586.04–592.01. It is just below the 5-day ($590.1) and above the 10-day ($583.2), 30-day ($550.6), 100-day ($518.2) and 200-day ($501.5), all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 8, above zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 30 ($577.15), and RSI is 73.1, still overbought but off its 82.7 peak.
read.zh: 伯克希尔 B 11月17日下跌 1.0%，收于 $586.76，盘中区间 $586.04–592.01。股价略低于 5 日均线（$590.1），位于 10 日（$583.2）、30 日（$550.6）、100 日（$518.2）和 200 日均线（$501.5）上方，均在上行。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线上方，在零轴上方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看多（$577.15），RSI 为 73.1，仍处超买区但已从 82.7 的高位回落。

read.en: The dip broke the $588.2–590.1 support (Nov 11 close, Nov 12 low, 5-day), now resistance, while the 10-day held. Resistance is $588.2–590.1, then $595.8–596.9 (Nov 16 high, 52-week high) and the round $600. Support is $583.2–583.3 (10-day, Nov 10 close), then $577.2–579.1 (SAR, Nov 4 close) and $570.9–572.3 (Nov 6 and 5 closes). A close above $590.1 would target $595.8–596.9; below $583, $577–579.

r.en: Nov 11 close $588.24; Nov 12 low $589.02; 5-day average $590.1, lost
